title: Listen: What do France’s centre-right candidates want for Europe?
lede: In the race for the French presidential election, there are already four names on the centre-right: Gabriel Attal, Bruno Retailleau, David Lisnard and Édouard Philippe. For now, they haven't reached an agreement to join forces and put forward a single candidate.
